title: 옷 이야기: 요즘 유행이에요? 저한테 어울려요?
objective: By the end, you can use words like 유행, 어울리다, 스타일, 옷, and 멋있다 in short sentences to talk about what people wear and how it looks or fits.
summary: Learn 10 everyday words for talking about clothes, trends, and how an outfit looks on someone.

task.title: Choose and complete
task.line: Use the word list on page 1 to choose, fill in, or order the Korean words.

words.exampleMeaning: I bought some clothes at the department store on the weekend.
This kind of bag is in style these days.

words.meaning: to look good on someone; to suit (about looks, not size)
words.example: 그 모자, 민수 씨한테 잘 어울려요.
words.exampleMeaning: That hat looks good on you, Minsu.
Is that a new jacket? It looks really cool!
Please wear comfortable sneakers when you come.
What color do you like best?
This dress is pretty and comfortable.

words.meaning: to fit (the size is right; about size, not looks — use 어울리다 for looks). If it is too small or too big, it doesn't fit (안 맞아요).

exercises: Choose 입어요 or 신어요: ① 구두를 (입어요 / 신어요). ② 치마를 (입어요 / 신어요). ③ 양말을 (입어요 / 신어요).
Fill in the blank with 어울려요 or 맞아요: ① 빨간색이 수진 씨한테 정말 잘 ____. ② 이 운동화는 너무 작아서 발에 안 ____.
Put the words in order to make a sentence (start with the time word 올해는): 유행이에요 / 올해는 / 밝은 색깔이
Choose the right word: ① 이 신발은 가벼워서 오래 걸어도 (편해요 / 멋있어요). ② 와, 그 코트 정말 (편해요 / 멋있어요)! 배우 같아요.
Fill in the blank with 스타일, 색깔, or 옷: ① 짧고 단정한 이 머리 ____이 정말 마음에 들어요. ② 검은색하고 흰색 중에서 어느 ____이 좋아요? ③ 날씨가 추워서 두꺼운 ____을 입었어요.
answers: ① 신어요 ② 입어요 ③ 신어요
① 스타일 ② 색깔 (색) ③ 옷
